item.text: {"search_note":"I searched directly for 2024 examples of prestige-driven, nationalist, revenge, manufactured-threat, diversionary, and regime-survival security claims. I did not find credible evidence of a classic external-war diversion or annexation drive. The clearest misclassification problem was domestic: security language around protests was used in a coercive, survival-oriented way, which is exactly the kind of blurring this lens is asking about.","evidence":[{"title":"PM Hasina reiterates call to China to help repatriate Rohingyas to Myanmar","publisher":"TBS News / UNB","date":"July 10, 2024","url":"https://www.tbsnews.net/bangladesh/pm-hasina-reiterates-call-china-help-repatriate-rohingyas-myanmar-895921","summary":"Hasina sought Chinese help to facilitate Rohingya repatriation through talks with Myanmar.
